verdict.rationale: Supermemory ships an API-key-gated REST API with official OpenAPI spec, TypeScript/Python SDKs, and a self-hosted single-binary deployment option that boots without Docker or manual config — all of which support non-interactive, scriptable use in CI/automation contexts (confirmed hands-on: keyless API calls return clean 401s against the live v3 API, consistent with programmatic bearer-token auth). However, the featured MCP integration path explicitly requires browser-based OAuth (no API key), which is not CI-friendly, and there is no explicit CI/CD pipeline example or GitHub Actions doc in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD or GitHub Actions documentation, confirmation of non-interactive self-hosted setup/config for automated pipelines.
